correctness.rationale: All fixed-cardinality positive-length differentiable barcode families are covered by a pointwise equal-value sorting lemma. At each filtration position, directional derivatives of sorted tent values merely permute the derivatives of original tents within tie blocks. Their pth-power sum is invariant on each side; a uniform support/Lipschitz bound permits dominated convergence, giving the exact half-lifetime integral. C1 paths yield metric length through their local Lipschitz property. 324 exact rational L1/L2/L3 secant comparisons over 18 families corroborate the derivation; collisions and strong differentiability are distinguished, and no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This addresses the explicitly stated unequal/moving-birth gap in the newly introduced landscape-velocity theory. The complete overlap-independent endpoint-only formula, all finite Lp speeds, collision robustness, and exact landscape path lengths are motivated tools for degree-one-and-higher persistence, where births are generally variable. The collision caveat separates true metric speed from potentially nonexistent strong derivatives. These conclusions are neither arbitrary isolated numbers nor mere restatements of known common-birth formulas.
